hero.title:
Find out *what your game will cost*
right here.
hero.lead: We help with game development in Unity. Just pick what you need and how big your project is to get a rough estimate, then go straight on to an inquiry. It's totally fine to just check the price and leave.

steps.title: Choose your game's size
steps.lead: If you're not sure, just pick the closest one. You can adjust it later.

steps.title: Choose what you need
steps.lead: You can pick more than one. Checking an item shows exactly what's included.

steps.title: Tell us the details
steps.lead: Fill in whatever you can. It's fine to leave a lot blank.

notes.title: About prices
notes.body: Prices shown are *rough estimates only*. We'll send a formal quote after hearing the details. All prices are in Japanese yen (JPY), tax included.

notes.title: About generative AI
notes.body: We use generative AI for programming and 3D models to keep costs and turnaround down. For 3D models, *if you release on Steam, they must be disclosed as AI-generated content on your store page*. Please keep this in mind when ordering.
